components.name: Link
components.description: Text link for navigation. Inherit — inside running text, takes the text colour; Accent — standalone link (“Show all”); Neutral — card and item titles; Subtle — legal and footer. Size follows Body/S·M·L. Underline is part of the variant (always on for Inherit/Subtle, on hover for Accent/Neutral). Not a button: for an action in place use Button Flat. React: <Link variant size>.
